records.literal_gloss: And set out [the] standard of [the] camp of [the] sons of Dan, gathering for all the camps, by their armies, and over its army [was] Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.

en.L: And the standard of the camp of the sons of Dan set out, [as] the rear guard of all the camps, by their armies; and over its army [was] Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
en.B: Last, the standard of the camp of Dan set out as the rear guard for all the camps, division by division, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command of its forces.
en.R: Last of all, the camp of the tribe of Dan set out, marching by its troops under its flag. It guarded the back of the whole line. Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai was its commander.

es.L: Y partió el estandarte del campamento de los hijos de Dan, [como] retaguardia de todos los campamentos, por sus ejércitos; y sobre su ejército [estaba] Ahiezer hijo de Amisadai.
es.B: Por último partió el estandarte del campamento de Dan, como retaguardia de todos los campamentos, división por división, con Ahiezer hijo de Amisadai al mando de sus fuerzas.
es.R: Al final de todo salió el campamento de la tribu de Dan, marchando por tropas bajo su bandera. Protegía la parte de atrás de toda la columna. Ahiezer, hijo de Amisadai, era su comandante.

fr.L: Et la bannière du camp des fils de Dan partit, [comme] arrière-garde de tous les camps, selon leurs armées ; et sur son armée [était] Ahiézer fils d’Ammishaddaï.
fr.B: Enfin, la bannière du camp de Dan partit, formant l’arrière-garde de tous les camps, division par division, avec Ahiézer fils d’Ammishaddaï à la tête de ses forces.
fr.R: Le camp de la tribu de Dan est parti en dernier, en marchant par troupes sous son drapeau. Il protégeait l’arrière de toute la colonne. Ahiézer, fils d’Ammishaddaï, en était le commandant.

sw.L: Na bendera ya kambi ya wana wa Dani ikasafiri, [kama] walinzi wa nyuma wa kambi zote, kwa majeshi yao; na juu ya jeshi lake [alikuwa] Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai.
sw.B: Mwisho, bendera ya kambi ya Dani ilisafiri ikiwa walinzi wa nyuma wa kambi zote, kikosi kwa kikosi, na Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai akiwa mkuu wa vikosi vyake.
sw.R: Mwisho kabisa, kambi ya kabila la Dani iliondoka, ikitembea kwa vikosi vyake chini ya bendera yake. Iliulinda upande wa nyuma wa msafara wote. Ahiezeri mwana wa Amishadai alikuwa kamanda wake.

vi.L: Và cờ hiệu của trại quân con cháu Đan ra đi, [làm] hậu quân cho tất cả các trại quân, theo các đạo quân của họ; và chỉ huy đạo quân của nó [là] A-hi-ê-xe con trai A-mi-sa-đai.
vi.B: Sau cùng, cờ hiệu của trại quân Đan ra đi làm hậu quân cho tất cả các trại quân, từng đội quân một, do A-hi-ê-xe con trai A-mi-sa-đai chỉ huy.
vi.R: Sau cùng, trại quân của chi tộc Đan lên đường, từng đội quân dưới cờ hiệu của mình. Họ canh giữ phía sau của cả đoàn. A-hi-ê-xe con trai A-mi-sa-đai chỉ huy họ.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 진의 후위로서 단 자손의 진의 기가 그들의 군대별로 길을 떠났다. 그리고 그 군대 위에는 암미삿대의 아들 아히에셀이 [있었다].
ko.B: 마지막으로 단 진의 깃발이 모든 진의 후위가 되어 부대별로 길을 떠났는데, 암미삿대의 아들 아히에셀이 그 군대를 지휘했다.
ko.R: 맨 마지막으로 단 지파의 진이 자기 깃발 아래 부대별로 행진하여 떠났다. 그들은 행렬 전체의 뒤를 지켰다. 그 지휘관은 암미삿대의 아들 아히에셀이었다.

pt.L: E partiu o estandarte do acampamento dos filhos de Dã, [como] retaguarda de todos os acampamentos, segundo os seus exércitos; e sobre o seu exército [estava] Aiezer, filho de Amisadai.
pt.B: Por último partiu o estandarte do acampamento de Dã, como retaguarda de todos os acampamentos, divisão após divisão. Aiezer, filho de Amisadai, comandava as suas tropas.
pt.R: Por último foi o acampamento da tribo de Dã. Marchou com as suas tropas, debaixo da sua bandeira. Ele protegia o fim da fila inteira. Aiezer, filho de Amisadai, era o comandante.

am.L: የዳንም ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ ለሰፈሮቹ ሁሉ ደጀን [ሆኖ] በየሠራዊታቸው ተነሣ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዜር [ነበረ]።
am.B: በመጨረሻም የዳን ሰፈር ዓላማ ለሰፈሮቹ ሁሉ ደጀን ሆኖ በየክፍለ ሠራዊቱ ተነሣ፤ ሠራዊቱንም የሚመራው የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዜር ነበረ።
am.R: ከሁሉም በመጨረሻ የዳን ነገድ ሰፈር በሰንደቅ ዓላማው ሥር በየጭፍሩ እየተጓዘ ተነሣ። ከተጓዦቹ ሁሉ ኋላ ሆኖ ይጠብቅ ነበር። አዛዡም የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዜር ነበረ።

decisions.choice: the rear guard: the one gathering up behind all the camps
decisions.reason: The word means "one who gathers". At the back of the march it names the troops who bring up the rear, protect it and gather any who fall behind (Joshua 6:9, 13; Isaiah 52:12).

decisions.choice: the camp of Dan: Dan, Asher and Naphtali
decisions.reason: Dan's camp, on the north (2:25-31), was the largest after Judah's and marched last, "last by their standards" (2:31). Its leaders are those of 1:12-15.

decisions.choice: Last
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable add "last", which the rear guard role implies (2:31).

decisions.choice: "ደጀን" (rear guard)
decisions.reason: "ደጀን" is the ordinary Amharic word for the force that guards the back of a marching army, the sense of the Hebrew "gatherer" (m1). Readable says it in plain words.

en.R: Pagiel son of Ochran commanded the troops of the tribe of Asher.

es.B: Paguiel hijo de Ocrán estaba al frente de las fuerzas de la tribu de Aser.
es.R: Paguiel, hijo de Ocrán, mandaba las tropas de la tribu de Aser.

fr.L: Et sur l’armée de la tribu des fils d’Aser [était] Paguiel fils d’Okrân.

ko.R: 오그란의 아들 바기엘은 아셀 지파의 부대를 지휘했다.

pt.B: Pagiel, filho de Ocrã, estava à frente das tropas da tribo de Aser.
pt.R: Pagiel, filho de Ocrã, comandava as tropas da tribo de Aser.

am.B: በአሴር ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዖክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል ነበረ።
am.R: የአሴርን ነገድ ጭፍሮች የሚመራው የዖክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል ነበረ።

es.R: Ahira, hijo de Enán, mandaba las tropas de la tribu de Neftalí.

sw.R: Ahira mwana wa Enani aliongoza vikosi vya kabila la Naftali.

vi.L: Và chỉ huy đạo quân của chi tộc con cháu Nép-ta-li [là] A-hi-ra con trai Ê-nan.
vi.B: A-hi-ra con trai Ê-nan chỉ huy đội quân của chi tộc Nép-ta-li.
vi.R: A-hi-ra con trai Ê-nan chỉ huy các đội quân của chi tộc Nép-ta-li.

ko.B: 에난의 아들 아히라는 납달리 지파의 군대를 맡았다.
ko.R: 에난의 아들 아히라는 납달리 지파의 부대를 지휘했다.

pt.L: E sobre o exército da tribo dos filhos de Naftali [estava] Aira, filho de Enã.
pt.B: Aira, filho de Enã, estava à frente das tropas da tribo de Naftali.
pt.R: Aira, filho de Enã, comandava as tropas da tribo de Naftali.

am.L: በንፍታሌምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ [ነበረ]።
am.B: በንፍታሌም ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ ነበረ።
am.R: የንፍታሌምን ነገድ ጭፍሮች የሚመራው የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ ነበረ።

decisions.choice: Ahira son of Enan: Naphtali's leader

source.text: אֵ֛לֶּה מַסְעֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְצִבְאֹתָ֑ם וַיִּסָּֽעוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: These [were the] settings out of [the] sons of Israel by their armies, and they set out.

en.L: These [were] the settings out of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel by their armies; and they set out.
en.B: Such was the order in which the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} marched by their divisions. Then they set out.
en.R: This was the order in which the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} marched, troop by troop. And so they set out.

es.L: Estas [fueron] las partidas de los hijos de Israel por sus ejércitos; y partieron.
es.B: Este era el orden de marcha de los israelitas, división por división. Entonces partieron.
es.R: Este era el orden en que marchaban los israelitas, tropa por tropa. Y así se pusieron en camino.

fr.L: Voilà les départs des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël selon leurs armées ; et ils partirent.
fr.B: Tel était l’ordre de marche des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}}, division par division. Puis ils partirent.
fr.R: C’est dans cet ordre que les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} marchaient, troupe par troupe. Et ils se sont mis en route.

sw.L: Hizi [ndizo] safari za wana wa Israeli kwa majeshi yao; nao wakasafiri.
sw.B: Huo ndio uliokuwa mpangilio wa safari za Waisraeli, kikosi kwa kikosi. Kisha wakasafiri.
sw.R: Huu ndio mpangilio ambao Waisraeli walitembea, kikosi kwa kikosi. Basi wakaanza safari.

vi.L: Đó [là] các cuộc ra đi của con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên theo các đạo quân của họ; và họ ra đi.
vi.B: Đó là thứ tự dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên đường theo từng đội quân. Rồi họ nhổ trại ra đi.
vi.R: Đó là thứ tự dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lên đường, từng đội quân một. Và họ lên đường như vậy.

ko.L: 이것이 이스라엘 자손이 그들의 군대별로 행진하는 순서[였다]. 그리고 그들이 길을 떠났다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 이와 같은 순서로 부대별로 행진했다. 그리고 그들은 길을 떠났다.
ko.R: 이것이 이스라엘 사람들이 부대별로 행진하는 순서였다. 이렇게 그들은 길을 떠났다.

pt.L: Estas [eram] as partidas dos filhos de Israel segundo os seus exércitos; e eles partiram.
pt.B: Essa era a ordem em que os israelitas marchavam, por divisões. Então eles partiram.
pt.R: Essa era a ordem em que os israelitas marchavam, tropa por tropa. E assim eles partiram.

am.L: የእስራኤል ልጆች ጉዞዎች በየሠራዊታቸው እነዚህ [ነበሩ]፤ ተጓዙም።
am.B: የእስራኤል ልጆች በየክፍለ ሠራዊታቸው የሚጓዙበት ቅደም ተከተል ይህ ነበረ። ከዚያም ተነሥተው ሄዱ።
am.R: እስራኤላውያን በየጭፍራቸው የሚጓዙበት ቅደም ተከተል ይህ ነበረ። እንዲህም ተጓዙ።

decisions.choice: these were the settings out ... and they set out: the order for every march, followed this time
decisions.reason: "Settings out" is plural: this is the order of march whenever Israel moved. The last verb, "and they set out", tells of the first departure from Sinai (verse 13) and closes the list. The plural also makes it the pattern for later stages.

decisions.choice: the marching order (Balanced); the order in which ... marched (Readable)
decisions.reason: The plural noun means the moves made in this arrangement. Balanced and Readable name the arrangement; Literal keeps "settings out".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֗ה לְ֠חֹבָב בֶּן־רְעוּאֵ֣ל הַמִּדְיָנִי֮ חֹתֵ֣ן מֹשֶׁה֒ נֹסְעִ֣ים׀אֲנַ֗חְנוּ אֶל־הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה אֹת֖וֹ אֶתֵּ֣ן לָכֶ֑ם לְכָ֤ה אִתָּ֨נוּ֙ וְהֵטַ֣בְנוּ לָ֔ךְ כִּֽי־יְהוָ֥ה דִּבֶּר־ט֖וֹב עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Moses to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, [the] father-in-law of Moses, setting out [are] we to the place which said Yahweh, it I will give to you; come with us, and we will do good to you, for Yahweh has spoken good concerning Israel.

en.L: And Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, the father-in-law of Moses, "We are setting out for the place of which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us, and we will do you good, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has spoken good concerning Israel."
en.B: Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would give us. Come with us and we will be good to you, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has promised Israel good things."
en.R: Moses spoke to Hobab son of Reuel. Hobab's family came from Midian, and they were related to Moses by marriage. Moses said, "We are leaving for the place {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} promised to give us. Come with us, and we will be kind to you, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has promised good things for Israel."

es.L: Y dijo Moisés a Hobab hijo de Reuel el madianita, suegro de Moisés: «Nosotros partimos hacia el lugar del cual {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo: “{{plural_you:Se lo daré a ustedes|Os lo daré}}”. Ven con nosotros, y te haremos bien, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha anunciado el bien para Israel».
es.B: Moisés dijo a Hobab hijo de Reuel el madianita, suegro de Moisés: «Partimos hacia el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo que nos daría. Ven con nosotros y te trataremos bien, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha prometido bienes a Israel».
es.R: Moisés habló con Hobab hijo de Reuel. La familia de Hobab era de Madián, y estaba emparentada con Moisés por matrimonio. Moisés le dijo: «Salimos hacia el lugar que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} prometió darnos. Ven con nosotros, y seremos buenos contigo, porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} ha prometido cosas buenas para Israel».

fr.L: Et Moïse dit à Hobab fils de Réuel le Madianite, beau-père de Moïse : « Nous partons vers le lieu dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit : “Je vous le donnerai.” Viens avec nous, et nous te ferons du bien, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a annoncé du bien pour Israël. »
fr.B: Moïse dit à Hobab fils de Réuel le Madianite, beau-père de Moïse : « Nous partons pour le lieu dont {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nous le donnerait. Viens avec nous, et nous serons bons pour toi, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis du bien à Israël. »
fr.R: Moïse a parlé à Hobab fils de Réuel. La famille de Hobab venait de Madian, et elle était liée à Moïse par mariage. Moïse lui a dit : « Nous partons pour le lieu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis de nous donner. Viens avec nous, et nous te traiterons bien, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a promis de bonnes choses à Israël. »

sw.L: Na Musa akamwambia Hobabu mwana wa Reueli Mmidiani, baba mkwe wa Musa, "Sisi tunasafiri kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema, 'Nitawapa ninyi mahali hapo.' Njoo pamoja nasi, nasi tutakutendea mema, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amenena mema kuhusu Israeli."
sw.B: Musa alimwambia Hobabu mwana wa Reueli Mmidiani, baba mkwe wa Musa, "Tunaondoka kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema atatupa. Njoo pamoja nasi, nasi tutakutendea wema, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameahidi mambo mema kwa Israeli."
sw.R: Musa alizungumza na Hobabu mwana wa Reueli. Jamaa ya Hobabu ilitoka Midiani, nayo ilikuwa na uhusiano na Musa kwa ndoa. Musa alisema, "Tunaondoka kwenda mahali ambapo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliahidi kutupa. Njoo pamoja nasi, nasi tutakutendea mema, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameahidi mambo mema kwa ajili ya Israeli."

vi.L: Và Môi-se nói với Hô-báp con trai Rê-u-ên người Ma-đi-an, cha vợ của Môi-se: "Chúng tôi đang ra đi đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán: 'Ta sẽ ban nơi ấy cho các ngươi.' Hãy đi với chúng tôi, và chúng tôi sẽ làm điều tốt cho ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán điều tốt lành về Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.B: Môi-se nói với Hô-báp con trai Rê-u-ên người Ma-đi-an, cha vợ của Môi-se: "Chúng tôi đang lên đường đến nơi mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán là {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ ban cho chúng tôi. Xin ông hãy đi với chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ đối xử tốt với ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa ban điều tốt lành cho Y-sơ-ra-ên."
vi.R: Môi-se nói chuyện với Hô-báp con trai Rê-u-ên. Gia đình Hô-báp là người Ma-đi-an, và họ có họ hàng bên vợ với Môi-se. Môi-se nói: "Chúng tôi sắp lên đường đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa ban cho chúng tôi. Xin ông hãy đi với chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ đối xử tử tế với ông, vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã hứa ban những điều tốt lành cho Y-sơ-ra-ên."

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 모세의 장인인 미디안 사람 르우엘의 아들 호밥에게 말하였다. "우리는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 '내가 그것을 너희에게 주겠다'고 말씀하신 그곳으로 떠나고 있습니다. 우리와 함께 가십시다. 우리가 당신을 잘 대하겠습니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에 관하여 좋은 일을 말씀하셨기 때문입니다."

am.L: ሙሴም የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ሆባብን፣ የሙሴን አማት፣ አለው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} “ለእናንተ እሰጠዋለሁ” ወዳለው ስፍራ እንጓዛለን፤ ከእኛ ጋር ና፤ መልካምም እናደርግልሃለን፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእስራኤል መልካም ተናግሯልና።»
am.B: ሙሴም የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ሆባብን፣ የሙሴን አማት፣ እንዲህ አለው፦ «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሊሰጠን ቃል ወደ ገባበት ስፍራ እንጓዛለን። ከእኛ ጋር ና፤ መልካም እናደርግልሃለን፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ለእስራኤል መልካም ነገርን ተስፋ ሰጥቷልና።»

decisions.choice: the father-in-law of Moses: either Reuel or Hobab
decisions.reason: The phrase may describe Reuel, who is Moses' father-in-law in Exodus 2:18-21, or Hobab, who is called Moses' father-in-law in Judges 4:11. Moses' father-in-law is also called Jethro (Exodus 3:1; 18:1). The word may also have had a wider sense, a man related by marriage, which would let Hobab be Moses' brother-in-law. The Hebrew allows either reading, and every level keeps the same order so as not to decide.

decisions.choice: the Midianite: from a desert people who knew the wilderness
decisions.reason: Midian was a people of the desert regions east and south of Canaan. Moses had lived among them as a shepherd for many years (Exodus 2:15; 3:1), and Hobab knew the wilderness well (verse 31).

decisions.choice: we will do good to you ... the LORD has spoken good: a share in God's promised blessing
decisions.reason: The same word "good" ties the two halves together. God has promised good to Israel, the land and its blessings, and Moses offers Hobab a share in that good.

decisions.choice: the place the LORD said he would give us
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give God's promise as reported speech, so "you" in the promise becomes "us". Literal keeps the quotation.

decisions.choice: Hobab's family came from Midian, and they were related to Moses by marriage.
decisions.reason: Readable keeps the open question of m1 by saying only that the family was related to Moses by marriage, which is true on either reading.

decisions.choice: "Hobab hijo de Reuel el madianita, suegro de Moisés"
alternatives: "Hobab, suegro de Moisés, hijo de Reuel"
decisions.reason: As in the English, "suegro de Moisés" stays at the end, where it can describe either Reuel or Hobab; the Spanish does not choose between them (see the meaning note).

decisions.choice: "Hobab fils de Réuel le Madianite, beau-père de Moïse"
alternatives: "Hobab, beau-père de Moïse, fils de Réuel"
decisions.reason: As in the English, "beau-père de Moïse" stays at the end, where it can describe either Réuel or Hobab; the French does not choose between them (see the meaning note).

decisions.choice: "Hobabu mwana wa Reueli Mmidiani"
decisions.reason: The name takes the usual Swahili final vowel (Hobabu), and Reueli is the form already used in Genesis and Exodus. "Baba mkwe wa Musa" stays at the end (L, B), where it can describe either man, as in the English.

decisions.choice: Moses and Hobab speak as "tôi" / "chúng tôi" and "ông"
decisions.reason: Two grown men of different peoples, related by marriage, speak politely and as equals; "cha" would settle that Hobab himself is the father-in-law, which the meaning decision leaves open.

decisions.choice: "모세의 장인인 미디안 사람 르우엘의 아들 호밥": the phrase "모세의 장인인" stands first, so it can belong to Reuel or to Hobab
alternatives: 미디안 사람 르우엘의 아들이며 모세의 장인인 호밥
decisions.reason: The meaning decision leaves open whether Reuel or Hobab is Moses' father-in-law. Placing "모세의 장인인" before the whole name lets Korean keep the same ambiguity; putting it next to "호밥" would decide for Hobab.

decisions.choice: Moses speaks to Hobab in 합쇼체 with "당신" and "우리"; Hobab answers in the plain style (verse 30)
decisions.reason: Hobab is Moses' elder by marriage, so Moses speaks to him respectfully; Hobab, as the elder, answers in the plain style. A reviewer may prefer 해요체 for both.

decisions.choice: Hobabe; sogro de Moisés (L, B); parentes de Moisés por casamento (R); você
decisions.reason: "Hobabe" gives the name a Portuguese ending, as "Calebe", "Moabe" and "Horebe" do. Like the English, Literal and Balanced leave open whether "sogro" goes with Reuel or Hobab (m1); Readable says only that the family was related by marriage. Moses speaks to Hobab as a man to a man, with "você".

decisions.choice: "የሙሴን አማት" (Moses' father-in-law) set after the names, in apposition, as in the Hebrew
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves it open whether Reuel or Hobab is meant (m1). Placed before the names, Amharic would tie the word to Reuel; placed after, it stays as open as the Hebrew. Readable says only that they were related by marriage, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Moses says "አንተ" to Hobab ("ና", "እናደርግልሃለን"), and Hobab answers plainly
decisions.reason: By the rule settled in Genesis and Exodus, family members, in-laws included, say "አንተ" to one another; Moses' "እባክህ" in 10:31 carries the courtesy.

decisions.choice: you will be eyes for us: you will be our guide
decisions.reason: To be someone's eyes is to see for them, to guide them where they cannot see the way (compare Job 29:15). Hobab knew the desert, its water and its routes.

decisions.choice: for because thus: since you know
decisions.reason: The joined words give the reason for the request: Hobab's knowledge of the wilderness is why Moses wants him to stay.

decisions.choice: a human guide beside God's guidance
decisions.reason: The cloud and the ark show Israel when to move and where to stop (9:17-23; verses 33-34). Moses still asks for a man who knows the desert. The text does not set the two against each other.

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, if you will go with us, and it will be the good, that which will do good Yahweh with us, and we will do good to you.

en.L: And it shall be, if you go with us, that the good which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does for us, we will do for you."
en.B: If you go with us, then whatever good {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} does for us, we will do the same for you."
en.R: If you come along, you will get a share of every good thing {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gives us."

es.L: Y será, si vienes con nosotros, que el bien que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos haga, te lo haremos a ti».
es.B: Si vienes con nosotros, todo el bien que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos haga, lo haremos también contigo».
es.R: Si vienes con nosotros, tendrás parte en todas las cosas buenas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nos dé».

fr.R: Si tu viens avec nous, tu auras ta part de toutes les bonnes choses que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} nous donnera. »

sw.B: Ukienda pamoja nasi, wema wowote ambao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatutendea, sisi nasi tutakutendea vivyo hivyo."
sw.R: Ukija pamoja nasi, utapata sehemu ya kila kitu kizuri ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atatupa."

vi.L: Và sẽ xảy ra, nếu ông đi với chúng tôi, thì điều tốt mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho chúng tôi, chúng tôi sẽ làm cho ông."
vi.B: Nếu ông đi với chúng tôi, thì bất cứ điều tốt lành nào {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho chúng tôi, chúng tôi cũng sẽ làm như vậy cho ông."
vi.R: Nếu ông đi cùng, ông sẽ được chia phần mọi điều tốt lành mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban cho chúng tôi."

ko.R: 당신이 우리와 함께 가면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 우리에게 주시는 모든 좋은 것을 당신도 함께 누리게 될 것입니다."

decisions.choice: the good which the LORD does for us, we will do for you: a promise to share
decisions.reason: The verse repeats the word "good" three times. Whatever good God gives Israel, Israel will pass on to Hobab.

decisions.choice: if you go with us: the outcome is not told here
decisions.reason: The story does not say whether Hobab went. Later his descendants, the Kenites, are found living among the people of Judah in the land (Judges 1:16; 4:11), which suggests that he or his family did come.

decisions.choice: we will do the same for you (Balanced); you will get a share (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "do the same" for the repeated verb "do good"; Readable puts the promise as a share in the good God gives. Literal keeps the repeated words.

records.literal_gloss: And they set out from [the] mountain of Yahweh [a] journey of three days, and [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh setting out before them [a] journey of three days to seek out for them [a] resting place.

en.L: And they set out from the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, a journey of three days; and the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was setting out before them, a journey of three days, to search out a resting place for them.
en.B: They left the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and marched three days, and all three days the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} went ahead of them, searching out a resting place for them.
en.R: The people left the mountain of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and walked for three days. The ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the sacred chest, led the way all three days. It went ahead to find a place where they could stop and rest.

es.L: Y partieron del monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, camino de tres días; y el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} partía delante de ellos, camino de tres días, para buscarles un lugar de descanso.
es.B: Dejaron el monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y marcharon tres días, y durante los tres días el arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} fue delante de ellos, buscándoles un lugar de descanso.
es.R: El pueblo dejó el monte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y caminó durante tres días. El arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el cofre sagrado, fue al frente los tres días. Iba adelante para encontrar un lugar donde pudieran parar y descansar.

fr.L: Et ils partirent de la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, un chemin de trois jours ; et l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} partait devant eux, un chemin de trois jours, pour leur chercher un lieu de repos.
fr.B: Ils quittèrent la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et marchèrent trois jours ; pendant ces trois jours, l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} alla devant eux pour leur chercher un lieu de repos.
fr.R: Le peuple a quitté la montagne {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et a marché pendant trois jours. L’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le coffre sacré, a ouvert la route pendant ces trois jours. Elle allait devant pour trouver un endroit où ils pourraient s’arrêter et se reposer.

am.L: {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ተራራም የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ተጓዙ፤ {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ኪዳን ታቦትም ማረፊያ ይፈልግላቸው ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ በፊታቸው ይጓዝ ነበር።

am.R: ሕዝቡ {{divine_name:ከእግዚአብሔር|ከያህዌ}} ተራራ ተነሥተው ሦስት ቀን ተጓዙ። {{divine_name:የእግዚአብሔር|የያህዌ}} ቃል ኪዳን ታቦት በሦስቱም ቀን በፊታቸው እየሄደ መራቸው። የሚቆሙበትንና የሚያርፉበትን ስፍራ ለማግኘት ቀድሞ ይሄድ ነበር።

decisions.choice: the mountain of Yahweh: Mount Sinai
decisions.reason: Sinai, also called Horeb, is "the mountain of God" where God met Moses and gave the covenant (Exodus 3:1; 19:20).

decisions.choice: before them a journey of three days: ahead of them during the three days' march
alternatives: a three days' distance ahead of them
decisions.reason: The phrase "a journey of three days" comes twice. The first time it is the length of the march. The second time it most likely means the same three days, with the ark going ahead of the people. It could also be read as the ark going a three days' distance ahead, which is unlikely, since the people followed it. The repeated phrase may also have been copied twice by mistake.

decisions.choice: the ark went before them: at the head of the march
decisions.reason: In 2:17 and verse 21 the holy things travel in the middle of the camps. Here the ark goes ahead to lead. It may have been carried in front on this first journey, or the verse may speak of the ark as the one who leads, as God goes before his people (Deuteronomy 1:33; Joshua 3:3-6).

decisions.choice: to search out a resting place: to find where they would stop and camp
decisions.reason: The verb is used of scouting land (13:2). The "resting place" is the next campsite, but the word also carries the hope of the rest God promised in the land (Deuteronomy 12:9; Psalm 95:11).

decisions.choice: the sacred chest
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the ark was, as the terms for this book allow, and keeps the word "ark".

decisions.choice: "l'arche ..., le coffre sacré"
decisions.reason: As the English Readable adds "the sacred chest", French keeps "l'arche" and adds "le coffre sacré", since "arche" is otherwise read as Noah's boat or an arch.

decisions.choice: "sanduku ..., lile sanduku takatifu"
decisions.reason: Swahili "sanduku" already means a chest, so the English Readable's added explanation becomes "lile sanduku takatifu" (that holy chest), naming what made it different.

decisions.choice: "언약궤" for the ark of the covenant; Readable adds "거룩한 상자인" once
decisions.reason: The term sheet's word. Readable explains "궤" once, as the English Readable adds "the sacred chest".

decisions.choice: a arca ... a caixa sagrada
decisions.reason: Readable keeps "arca" and adds what it was, as the English Readable does; "caixa sagrada" is plain and does not suggest a piece of furniture as "baú" might.

decisions.choice: "ታቦት" (ark) with no gloss at Readable
alternatives: adding "የተቀደሰው ሣጥን" (the sacred chest), as the English Readable adds
decisions.reason: "ታቦት" is a word every Amharic reader knows from church, so the explanation the English Readable needs for "ark" is not needed here.

records.literal_gloss: And [the] cloud of Yahweh [was] over them by day, when they set out from the camp.

en.L: And the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [was] over them by day, when they set out from the camp.
en.B: By day the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was above them whenever they moved out from the camp.
en.R: During the day, the cloud of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} stayed over them whenever they moved on from their camp.

es.L: Y la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [estaba] sobre ellos de día, cuando partían del campamento.
es.B: De día, la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba sobre ellos siempre que salían del campamento.
es.R: Durante el día, la nube {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se quedaba sobre ellos cada vez que dejaban su campamento.

fr.L: Et la nuée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [était] au-dessus d’eux le jour, quand ils partaient du camp.
fr.B: Le jour, la nuée {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était au-dessus d’eux chaque fois qu’ils quittaient le camp.
fr.R: Pendant la journée, le nuage {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} restait au-dessus d’eux chaque fois qu’ils quittaient leur camp.

sw.L: Na wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [lilikuwa] juu yao mchana, walipokuwa wakisafiri kutoka kambini.
sw.B: Mchana wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilikuwa juu yao kila walipoondoka kambini.
sw.R: Wakati wa mchana, wingu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} lilibaki juu yao kila walipoondoka kwenye kambi yao.

vi.B: Ban ngày, đám mây của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên họ mỗi khi họ rời trại quân ra đi.
vi.R: Vào ban ngày, đám mây của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên họ mỗi khi họ rời khu trại lên đường.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 진에서 떠날 때에 낮에는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 구름이 그들 위에 [있었다].

ko.R: 낮 동안 그들이 진을 떠나 움직일 때마다 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 구름이 그들 위에 머물러 있었다.

pt.L: E a nuvem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [estava] sobre eles de dia, quando partiam do acampamento.
pt.B: De dia, a nuvem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficava sobre eles sempre que partiam do acampamento.
pt.R: Durante o dia, a nuvem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} ficava em cima deles sempre que eles saíam do lugar onde tinham acampado.

decisions.choice: the cloud of Yahweh over them: God's presence covering and guiding
decisions.reason: The cloud that rested on the tabernacle (9:15-16) also went over the people on the march, a sign that God was with them (Exodus 13:21-22; Psalm 105:39).

decisions.choice: when they set out from the camp: whenever they left a campsite
decisions.reason: The form describes what happened each time the people moved on. "The camp" is the place where they had camped.

decisions.choice: the order of verses 34-36
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation places this verse after verses 35-36. The Hebrew order is followed here.

source.text: וַיְהִ֛י בִּנְסֹ֥עַ הָאָרֹ֖ן וַיֹּ֣אמֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה קוּמָ֣ה׀יְהוָ֗ה וְיָפֻ֨צוּ֙ אֹֽיְבֶ֔יךָ וְיָנֻ֥סוּ מְשַׂנְאֶ֖יךָ מִפָּנֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when set out the ark, and said Moses, rise up, Yahweh, and let be scattered your enemies, and let flee those hating you from before you.

en.L: And it happened, when the ark set out, that Moses said, \q "Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies be scattered, \q and let those who hate {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} flee from before {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.B: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, \q "Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies scatter, \q and let those who hate {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} run from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: Whenever the ark started out, Moses said, \q "Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Scatter {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} enemies. \q Make those who hate {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} run away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."

es.L: Y sucedió, cuando partía el arca, que Moisés dijo: \q «Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y sean esparcidos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos, \q y huyan los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odian de delante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.B: Cada vez que el arca partía, Moisés decía: \q «¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos se dispersen, \q y que los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odian huyan de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}».
es.R: Cada vez que el arca se ponía en marcha, Moisés decía: \q «¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Dispersa a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} enemigos. \q Haz que huyan de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odian».

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand l’arche partait, que Moïse dit : \q « Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis soient dispersés, \q et que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} haïssent fuient devant {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face ! »
fr.B: Chaque fois que l’arche partait, Moïse disait : \q « Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! \q Que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis se dispersent, \q et que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} haïssent s’enfuient loin de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! »
fr.R: Chaque fois que l’arche se mettait en route, Moïse disait : \q « Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Disperse {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} ennemis. \q Fais fuir loin de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} détestent ! »

sw.L: Ikawa, sanduku lilipokuwa likisafiri, Musa alisema, \q "Inuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} watawanyishwe, \q na wanaokuchukia wakimbie kutoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}."
sw.B: Kila sanduku lilipoanza safari, Musa alisema, \q "Inuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} na watawanyike, \q na wanaokuchukia wakukimbie."
sw.R: Kila sanduku lilipoanza kwenda, Musa alisema, \q "Inuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Watawanye adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. \q Wafanye wanaokuchukia wakimbie mbali {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}."

vi.L: Và xảy ra, khi hòm ra đi, thì Môi-se nói: \q "Xin trỗi dậy, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q và nguyện kẻ thù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bị tản lạc, \q và những kẻ ghét {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chạy trốn khỏi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Mỗi khi hòm giao ước ra đi, Môi-se nói: \q "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin trỗi dậy! \q Nguyện kẻ thù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tan chạy, \q và những kẻ ghét {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trốn chạy khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.R: Mỗi khi hòm giao ước lên đường, Môi-se nói: \q "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin trỗi dậy! Xin làm cho kẻ thù {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tan chạy. \q Xin khiến những kẻ ghét {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phải chạy trốn khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그리고 궤가 떠날 때에 모세가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 일어나십시오. \q 주님의 원수들이 흩어지게 하시고, \q 주님을 미워하는 자들이 주님 앞에서 달아나게 하십시오."
ko.B: 궤가 떠날 때마다 모세는 이렇게 말했다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 일어나십시오! \q 주님의 원수들이 흩어지게 하시고, \q 주님을 미워하는 자들이 주님 앞에서 도망치게 하십시오."
ko.R: 궤가 떠날 때마다 모세는 말했다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 일어나십시오! 주님의 원수들을 흩으십시오. \q 주님을 미워하는 사람들이 주님에게서 도망치게 하십시오."

pt.L: E aconteceu que, quando a arca partia, Moisés dizia: \q "Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q e sejam dispersos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos, \q e fujam de diante de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odeiam."
pt.B: Sempre que a arca partia, Moisés dizia: \q "Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! \q Que os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos se dispersem, \q e que fujam de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odeiam."
pt.R: Sempre que a arca começava a andar, Moisés dizia: \q "Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! Espalha os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} inimigos. \q Faz fugir de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} odeiam."

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ታቦቱ በተነሣ ጊዜ ሙሴ እንዲህ አለ፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተነሥ፤ \q ጠላቶችህም ይበተኑ፤ \q የሚጠሉህም ከፊትህ ይሽሹ።»
am.B: ታቦቱ በተነሣ ቁጥር ሙሴ እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተነሥ! \q ጠላቶችህ ይበተኑ፤ \q የሚጠሉህም ከአንተ ይሽሹ።»
am.R: ታቦቱ መጓዝ በጀመረ ቁጥር ሙሴ እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተነሥ! ጠላቶችህን በትናቸው። \q የሚጠሉህንም ከፊትህ አባርራቸው።»

decisions.choice: verses 35-36 are set apart in the Hebrew text
decisions.reason: In the Hebrew manuscripts these two verses are set off before and after by a special mark, a letter nun written backward. Ancient Jewish tradition treated them as a section of their own. The marks are not words and are not translated.

decisions.choice: when the ark set out, Moses said: what Moses said each time
decisions.reason: The verse describes a custom: the words were said whenever the ark set out, as verse 36 has "he would say" whenever it rested.

decisions.choice: rise up, Yahweh: a call to God to go out as a warrior
decisions.reason: "Rise up" calls God to act, here to go out before his people against their enemies. The ark is the sign of his presence. The saying is taken up in Psalm 68:2 and in Psalm 132:8, where the ark comes to its resting place.

decisions.choice: let {dp('your')} enemies be scattered: a prayer that God's enemies flee
decisions.reason: The verbs express a wish or prayer. The enemies are God's own, "those who hate you": Israel's battles are fought in God's name.

decisions.choice: run from you
decisions.reason: Balanced says "run from" for "flee from before", the sense of the Hebrew phrase.

decisions.choice: Scatter your enemies. Make those who hate you run away
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wishes into requests addressed to God, who is the one who scatters them. The meaning, a prayer that God drive off his enemies, is the same.

decisions.choice: "Levántate" with no span; "{{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}}", "{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}", "{{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}"
decisions.reason: A clitic joined to the verb takes no span in Spanish, as set for these books; the free pronouns and possessives take it.

decisions.choice: "Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}", "{{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}}", "{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}}"
decisions.reason: French puts the setting on every pronoun addressed to God, including the "toi" joined to the imperative; "ta face" at Literal renders "from before you".

decisions.choice: "adui {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}", "mbele {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}", "mbali {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}"
decisions.reason: Swahili marks "you" inside "wanaokuchukia" and "wakukimbie", where no capital is possible; only the free possessives and "nawe" take the span.

decisions.choice: "Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}" for the vocative, with "xin" before the request
decisions.reason: Vietnamese addresses God in prayer with "Lạy" and softens a request to God with "xin", as in the Psalms; Literal keeps the Hebrew order, the request first.

decisions.choice: Moses prays in 합쇼체 ("일어나십시오", "-하십시오") and calls God "주님" for "you"; no deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: People speak to God in prayer forms, as the Genesis sheet and the Korean Psalms do; Korean has no capital letters for the pronoun setting to change. The lines follow the English breaks, each wish its own line.

decisions.choice: Levanta-te, SENHOR; tu (teus, ti, te)
decisions.reason: Moses speaks to God, so with "tu" and its pronouns under the deity_pronoun setting, and "SENHOR" is a vocative without an article, as in Exodus 15. "Levanta-te" is the call for God to go out and act (m3).

decisions.choice: Set in lines at every level, as the English, with "ሆይ" for the address to the LORD
alternatives: running the prayer on as prose
decisions.reason: The two prayers of 10:35-36 stand apart in the Hebrew (m1) and are set as poetry in this translation; Amharic keeps a line break wherever the English level has one.

ko.L: 그리고 그것이 쉴 때에는 그가 말하였다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 돌아오십시오, \q 이스라엘의 수천의 수만 [무리]에게로."
ko.B: 궤가 멈출 때마다 그는 말했다. \q "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 돌아오십시오, \q 이스라엘의 수천수만 백성에게로."

pt.B: E, sempre que ela parava, ele dizia: \q "Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q para os milhares e milhares de Israel."
pt.R: Quando a arca parava, Moisés dizia: \q "Volta, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, para junto dos milhares e milhares de Israel."

am.L: ባረፈም ጊዜ እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተመለስ፤ \q [ወደ] እስራኤል አእላፋት ሺዎች።»
am.B: ታቦቱ ባረፈ ቁጥርም እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ \q ወደ እስራኤል እልፍ አእላፋት ተመለስ።»
am.R: ታቦቱ በቆመ ጊዜ ሙሴ እንዲህ ይል ነበር፦ \q «{{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ወደ ብዙ ሺህ እስራኤላውያን ተመለስ።»

decisions.choice: return, Yahweh, to the ten thousands: come back and stay among the people
alternatives: Restore, LORD, the ten thousands of Israel
Return, LORD of the ten thousands of Israel
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no word for "to". The most likely reading is a call for God to return and dwell among his people when the march stops, as "rise up" in verse 35 was a call for him to go out. The verb can also mean "bring back" or "restore", which would make it a prayer for Israel's numbers. Another reading is "Return, Yahweh of the ten thousands".

decisions.choice: the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel: the whole great people
decisions.reason: "Ten thousands" and "thousands" are the largest numbers the language uses, put together to mean a vast multitude. "The thousands of Israel" may also be its divisions (verse 4).

decisions.choice: when it rested: when the ark stopped and was set down
decisions.reason: The verb is related to the "resting place" the ark went to find (verse 33).

decisions.choice: thousands upon thousands (Balanced); thousands and thousands (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable express the doubled number word as a vast number. Literal keeps the Hebrew words.

decisions.choice: the ark stopped, Moses said
decisions.reason: Readable names the ark and Moses for "it" and "he".

decisions.choice: "las miríadas"
decisions.reason: "Miríada" is ten thousand, used of a vast number, and keeps the two number words of the Hebrew distinct ("miríadas", "millares").

decisions.choice: "les myriades"
decisions.reason: "Myriade" is the French word for ten thousand, used of a vast number, and keeps the two number words of the Hebrew distinct ("myriades", "milliers").

decisions.choice: "수천의 수만" (Literal) and "수천수만" (Balanced, Readable) for "the ten thousands of the thousands"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps both numbers in the Hebrew order; the other levels use the ordinary Korean phrase for a countless number.

decisions.choice: as dezenas de milhares dos milhares
decisions.reason: Literal keeps both number words; "miríade" is a rare word in Brazilian Portuguese, so "dezenas de milhares" says the larger number plainly.
